topics.title: Getting started
topics.summary: SOSkúška helps you prepare for exams on your own computer. Everything works offline; AI features are optional.

steps: Open **My Subjects**, choose **New subject**, enter a name and, optionally, an exam date in YYYY-MM-DD format, then choose **Save subject**.
Choose **Questions** on the subject to write multiple-choice questions, or open **Flashcards** and create a deck for it.
On the **Dashboard**, pick the subject and choose **Start Studying** to run a focus session.
Check yourself in **Practice Tests**, then see your progress in **Statistics**.

bullets: A new installation is empty. SOSkúška never adds sample subjects or invented statistics.
Your data is saved in a file on this computer as soon as you save a form or finish a session.
Press F1 on any page (Cmd+? on a Mac) to open help for that page.

topics.title: Dashboard and focus sessions
topics.summary: Time your study with a focus timer and keep an eye on your day, streak and upcoming exams.

steps: Choose a subject in the Focus room. A session always belongs to one subject.
Choose **Start Studying**. The timer counts down from your focus duration (15 minutes unless you change it in Settings).
Use **Pause** and **Resume** for breaks.
Choose **Finish** to save the time you actually studied. Reaching the target and closing the window normally also save it.

bullets: Total study time, study sessions, your current streak of study days and the number of subjects.
Your **Daily goal** progress, a small checklist (**Review a subject** is ticked by you; **Complete a focus session** ticks itself) and a calendar with exam dates.
Upcoming exams and recent study sessions. The subject search filters only the cards on this page.

blocks.heading: If the app closed during a session

blocks.text: The timer saves a checkpoint about every five seconds. After a crash, the Dashboard offers **Recover paused** (continue from the checkpoint, paused) or **Discard checkpoint** (needs a second click). Time while the app was closed is never counted.
If saving fails, the timer pauses and the sidebar shows **Focus needs saving**. Choose **Finish** again to retry; do not force-quit the app.

topics.title: Subjects and exam dates
topics.summary: Subjects organise everything else: focus time, questions, decks and practice tests.

steps: Open **My Subjects** and choose **New subject**.
Enter a unique name, an optional description and an optional exam date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Choose **Save subject**. Use **Edit** later to change it.

bullets: Exam dates appear in the Dashboard calendar and in Upcoming exams.
**Delete** asks for confirmation first. It removes the subject's topics and questions, but saved study time, completed practice tests and flashcard decks are kept.
If another window changes the subject while you confirm, the warning is refreshed and you confirm again.
A subject cannot be deleted while a focus session for it is open.

topics.title: Question bank
topics.summary: Write your own multiple-choice questions, grouped by optional topics.

blocks.text: In **My Subjects**, choose **Questions** on a subject to open its question bank.

bullets: **New topic** creates a topic. Deleting a topic moves its questions to No topic.
**New question** needs a question text, four different answers A–D, exactly one correct answer and a difficulty (Easy, Medium or Hard). An explanation is optional.
Search looks through question text; filters narrow by topic and difficulty. The list shows 50 questions per page.
Correct answers are visible here because this is where you write them.
Your unsaved text is kept if saving fails or another window changed the same question.

blocks.text: You can also add many questions at once with **Import CSV** or draft them from your notes with **Generate with AI**.

topics.title: Practice tests
topics.summary: Test yourself with random questions from your question bank.

steps: Choose a subject, a topic (or all topics) and a difficulty.
Choose how many questions (1–100) and a time limit: **Untimed** or 5 to 60 minutes.
Choose **Start test**. Questions are picked at random without repeats.

bullets: Every answer is saved immediately. Use **Previous**, **Next** and **Clear answer** to move around.
Only one test can be unfinished. If you leave or close the app, **Resume test** brings it back; a timed test keeps running while you are away.
**Finish test** asks for confirmation. Unanswered questions count as incorrect.
**Discard test** deletes the unfinished attempt after confirmation.

blocks.text: After finishing, you see your score, the correct answers and explanations. **Completed tests** lists all finished tests, 20 per page, with filters by subject and date; **View result** reopens one. Results never change when you later edit or delete questions.
On a result, **Explain this question** can prepare a question for the AI Tutor in one of four study modes: **Explain answer**, **Explain simply**, **Give me a hint** or **Quiz me**.

topics.title: Flashcards and review
topics.summary: Remember facts with decks of cards that come back when they are due.

steps: Open **Flashcards** and choose **New deck**. Each deck belongs to one subject.
Choose **Open deck**, then **New card**. Write the front (question) and the back (answer).
Choose **Study due** to review cards that are due. Try to recall the answer, then choose **Reveal answer**.
Rate yourself honestly: **Again**, **Hard**, **Good** or **Easy**.

bullets: Again: in 10 minutes. Hard: in 1 hour for new cards, otherwise a slightly longer interval.
Good: in 1 day for new cards, otherwise about 2.5 times the last interval. Easy: in 4 days, otherwise about 3.5 times. The maximum is one year.
Editing a card makes it due again now. Your earlier ratings are kept in **Review history**.
Ratings are your own judgement of how well you remembered, not a measured score.

topics.title: Statistics
topics.summary: See what you have done in the last 7 days, the last 30 days or all time.

bullets: Focus: saved study time and sessions, per subject and per day. Running or unsaved time is not included.
Practice tests: accuracy over completed tests, where every question counts the same and unanswered questions count as incorrect.
Flashcards: how many times you chose Again, Hard, Good and Easy.
Choose **Refresh** or reopen the page to update the numbers.

blocks.text: These numbers describe your saved activity; they do not measure how well you know a subject. Deleting a subject, deck or card does not remove its history from Statistics.

topics.title: AI Tutor (optional)
topics.summary: Chat with a model running in Ollama on your computer. Nothing is sent until you choose to.

steps: Install Ollama from ollama.com and download a model, for example by running: ollama pull llama3.2:3b
Open **AI Tutor** and choose **Connect / refresh**. The default server is http://127.0.0.1:11434 on your own computer.
Choose a model and an answer language, type your question and choose **Send**. **Stop** ends a reply early.

bullets: Only **Connect / refresh** and **Send** contact the server. Your subjects, questions and results are never attached automatically.
Chats are saved on this computer and included in backups. **New chat** starts a fresh conversation.
If a reply could not be saved, use **Retry save reply** or **Discard unsaved**.
AI answers can be wrong. Check them against your study materials.

topics.title: AI drafts from notes
topics.summary: Turn pasted notes into draft flashcards or questions, then keep only the good ones.

steps: Save your Ollama server and preferred model in **Settings** (or use **Use Tutor choices** there and save).
Open a deck in **Flashcards**, or a subject's question bank, and choose **Generate with AI**.
Paste your notes (up to 12,000 characters), choose how many items you want and choose **Generate**. Only now are the notes sent to the server shown in the panel.
Read every draft. Untick anything wrong, then choose **Save selected**.

bullets: Drafts marked ⚠ were not clearly found in your notes and start unticked. Tick them only after checking.
Drafts that break the usual rules, and repeated drafts, are listed and skipped.
Everything you selected is saved together, or nothing is saved and the problem is listed.
Your notes are not stored. Opening another deck or subject discards unsaved drafts.

topics.title: Importing from CSV
topics.summary: Add many questions or flashcards at once from a spreadsheet saved as CSV.

steps: Open a subject's question bank or a flashcard deck and choose **Import CSV**.
Choose **Save CSV template** to get an empty file with the right columns. Fill it in a spreadsheet and save it as comma-separated UTF-8 CSV.
Choose **Choose CSV…**. Check the preview with **Previous** and **Next**; nothing is saved yet.
Fix every listed problem, then choose **Import all**. All rows are saved together, or none are.

bullets: Question columns: prompt, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option (A–D), difficulty, and optionally topic and explanation.
Flashcard columns: front and back.
Files can be up to 2 MiB and 500 records. Exact duplicates are rejected, and existing items are never changed.
If you edit the file after previewing it, choose it again.

topics.title: Settings and language
topics.summary: Change your focus duration, daily goal, interface language, appearance and AI choices.

bullets: Focus duration (1–180 minutes) applies to your next session; a running session keeps its length.
Daily goal (1–1,440 minutes) updates the Dashboard straight away.
Interface language: English, Czech, Slovak or Russian. It applies after you restart the app.
Appearance: Light, Dark or System. It applies when you save.
AI: the Ollama server, preferred model and answer language. Saving never connects to the server.

blocks.text: Nothing changes until you choose **Save settings**. Unsaved changes stay while you visit other pages; **Reload** brings back the saved values after a second click.

topics.title: Backups and restore
topics.summary: Keep copies of your study data and bring them back if something goes wrong.

bullets: In **Settings**, choose **Create backup** and pick a new file name. Existing files are never overwritten.

For automatic copies, open **Daily local backups**, choose a folder with **Choose backup folder…**, tick **Enable daily backups** and choose **Save backup schedule**. The app makes one copy per day while it is open.

steps: Finish any focus session and practice test, and save forms you want to keep.
Choose **Choose backup…** and select a backup file. The app checks it and shows what it contains.
Choose **Confirm restore and close**. A safety copy of your current data is made first, then the app closes. Open it again to continue.

blocks.text: Restoring replaces all current study data, settings and AI chats. Backups are not encrypted; keep them somewhere safe.

topics.title: Your data and privacy
topics.summary: Your study data stays on this computer unless you choose to send something to an AI server.

bullets: By default, data is stored in one SQLite file: on macOS ~/Library/Application Support/SOSkuska/dashboard.sqlite3, on Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\SOSkuska\dashboard.sqlite3, on Linux $XDG_DATA_HOME/SOSkuska/dashboard.sqlite3 (usually ~/.local/share). If only an older ExamPrep folder holds your data, that file is used instead, and the --data option chooses another file.
There is no account, cloud sync or tracking. Studying, statistics, backups and this help all work offline.
The AI Tutor and AI drafts contact only the Ollama server you set, and only when you choose Connect, Send or Generate.
An optional read-only MCP server can let your own AI assistant read your study data. It is set up outside the app; see MCP_SERVER.md in the documentation.

topics.title: Keyboard shortcuts
topics.summary: A few keys make moving around faster.

bullets: F1, or Cmd+? on a Mac: open help for the current page.
Ctrl+K, or Cmd+K on a Mac: jump to the search field on the Dashboard, My Subjects, the question bank and Help.
Esc: clear that search, or cancel a pending discard of a saved focus checkpoint.
Enter in a practice-history date field: apply the filters.
The ‹ button at the top of the sidebar collapses it to icons; › expands it again.

topics.title: Troubleshooting
topics.summary: What to do when something does not work as expected.

bullets: AI not connected: start Ollama, check the server address in Settings and choose **Connect / refresh** in the AI Tutor. If no models appear, download one in Ollama first.
A reply says the model did not return valid JSON: try again, or choose a different model.
**Focus needs saving** in the sidebar: open the Dashboard and choose **Finish** to retry. Keep the app open until it succeeds.
A CSV import is rejected: fix every listed problem in the file and choose it again. Nothing is saved until the whole file is valid.
Something changed in another window: SOSkúška keeps your draft and asks you to reload or confirm again instead of overwriting newer data.
A message says data could not be saved or loaded: your draft is kept. Retry the same action. If it keeps failing, copy any text you need, restart the app and create a backup.
